ordinary_shared_storage.events/op_events: The current Table is events. Ordinary immutable audit rows remain generic; no ref-operation replay or authoritative delivery lifecycle may be encoded in the payload.
ordinary_shared_storage.jobs: Generic job requests/results, owner identity and process/workspace pins remain resource-owned; integration_operation_id is removed legacy coupling.
ordinary_shared_storage.projects: Ordinary configuration and integration-mode/repository selection are intent; legacy hierarchical drain/generation mirrors retire.
ordinary_shared_storage.sessions: Ordinary runtime identity, resume keys, status and claim bindings remain session-owned; integration-aware reconciler definitions are separately charged.
ordinary_shared_storage.task_metadata: Generic key/value mechanism remains task-owned. Every direct SQL/metadata API writer has an audited call and enclosing-code identity; duplicate delivery/repair state is marked retire.
ordinary_shared_storage.tasks: Ordinary status, completion identity, branch/source reference, PR URL, holds, gates and worker evidence remain task-owned; integration_mode is scheduling policy intent.
ordinary_shared_storage.workspaces: Ordinary repository/branch/generation identity and job pins remain workspace-owned; integration-specific adapters are separately charged.
